half_schematic_convention.quote: The 3S1 compressor assembly is shown as the top half of the schematic in Figure 1 and 3S2 as the lower half.

measured_running_tip_clearance_text.quote: Because of fabrication tolerances, the measured average running clearance was 0.037 cm (0.014 in.) for the 3S1 compressor and 0.043 cm (0.017 in.) for the 3S2 configuration.

measured_running_tip_clearance_table.quote: Average Running Tip Clearance cm 0.0366 0.033 0.0427 0.033; in. 0.0144 0.013 0.0168 0.013 (Table III, Test/Design)

running_clearance_measurement_method.value: dynamic rotor tip clearances from long-blade measurements at 18, 85, 100, 105 % speed, six circumferential locations per rotor
running_clearance_measurement_method.quote: Dynamic rotor tip clearances were calculated from measurements of the long blade clearances at 18, 85, 100, and 105 percent rotor speed. Measurements were recorded for each rotor at six circumferential locations.

trim_to_clearance.value: airfoils trimmed to specified tip clearances after assembly
trim_to_clearance.quote: All airfoils were designed to permit trimming to the specified tip clearances after assembly.

profile_type.value: circular-arc mean camber line, 65-series thickness distribution
profile_type.quote: Circular-arc mean-camber-line airfoils with a 65 series thickness distribution were chosen because of their excellent low-speed characteristics and to be consistent with the AMAC design.

endwall_overcamber.value: LE and TE overcamber at both endwalls; slight root LE overcamber on 2nd and 3rd stage blading
endwall_overcamber.quote: Leading edge and trailing edge overcambers were applied at both endwalls to align the blading to the anticipated endwall flow ... a slight overcamber (increased incidence angle) was added at the root leading edge of the second and third stage blading in order to prevent premature surge.

edge_radius.unit: mm (0.009 in.), constant LE and TE radius
edge_radius.quote: Leading and trailing edge radii were maintained at a constant 0.23 mm (0.009 in.).

axial_spacing_3S2.value: scaled by chord change between 3S1 and 3S2
axial_spacing_3S2.quote: The flowpath O.D. and I.D. were not changed, but the axial spacing between all the blade rows was scaled by the chord change between 3S1 and 3S2 so that each blade row would be affected by equivalent values of unmixed wake blockage.

blading_definition_stations.unit: radial stations per blade row (manufacturing definition)
blading_definition_stations.quote: Thirteen radial stations were selected to define the blade shape for each blade row.

blading_material.value: cast aluminium A356-T6, bolted to carriers (restaggerable)
blading_material.quote: A356-T6, an aluminum alloy used successfully for cast blading ... Blading attachment is accomplished by means of a bolt ... provides the option to restagger any or all blade rows

angle_convention.value: air angles beta = COT^-1(Vm/Vtheta), beta' = COT^-1(Vm/V'theta); metal angle beta* between tangent to mean camber line and meridional direction
angle_convention.quote: beta - Absolute air angle = COT-1 (Vm/Vtheta); beta' - Relative air angle = COT-1 (Vm)/(V'theta); beta* - Metal angle: angle between tangent to mean camber line and meridional direction; gamma - ... Blade chord angle: angle between chord and axial direction; delta0 - Deviation angle - exit air angle minus metal angle at trailing edge

blade_counts.quote: Not printed in CR-159714 or CR-159812 (no table or text gives the number of blades/vanes per row). Appendix D gives TAU/B (pitch/chord) and chord on cones, from which counts could be derived later.

test_speeds.quote: The performance program consisted of obtaining six sets of speedlines at each of three separate speeds: 85, 100, and 105 percent of design speed.
